MSTP_GLOBAL_VALID.desc: Configure valid global MST settings (rootguard_timeout omitted/pruned in mst mode).

MSTP_REGION_VALID.desc: Configure valid STP_MST region globals (name/revision/timers) in mst mode.

MSTP_INSTANCE_VALID.desc: Configure a valid STP_MST_INST instance with vlan list and bridge_priority.

MSTP_PORT_VALID.desc: Configure a valid STP_MST_PORT (per-instance per-port path_cost/priority).

MSTP_STP_PORT_MST_ATTRS_VALID.desc: Configure STP_PORT MST attributes (edge_port, link_type, guards) in mst mode.

MSTP_ROOTGUARD_TIMEOUT_IN_MST_VALID.desc: rootguard_timeout is valid in mst mode too (no longer restricted to pvst).

MSTP_REGION_IN_PVST.desc: STP_MST region config is allowed only in mst mode; in pvst it must fail.

MSTP_EDGE_PORT_IN_PVST.desc: edge_port=true is allowed only in mst mode; in pvst it must fail.
eStr: Mode must be MST, and EdgePort must be enabled for this configuration to be valid.

MSTP_LINK_TYPE_IN_PVST.desc: link_type is allowed only in mst mode; in pvst it must fail.
eStr: Configuration allowed in MST mode only

MSTP_PORTFAST_IN_MST.desc: portfast=true is allowed only in pvst mode; in mst it must fail.
eStr: Mode must be PVST, and PortFast must be enabled for this configuration to be valid.

PVST_GLOBAL_PRIORITY_NOT_MULTIPLE.desc: STP global priority that is not a multiple of 4096 is rejected.

PVST_VLAN_PRIORITY_NOT_MULTIPLE.desc: STP_VLAN priority that is not a multiple of 4096 is rejected.

PVST_VLAN_PRIORITY_MAX_VALID.desc: STP_VLAN priority 61440, the largest multiple of 4096, is accepted.

PVST_GLOBAL_PRIORITY_MULTIPLE_VALID.desc: STP global priority 4096, a multiple of 4096, is accepted.

MSTP_INSTANCE_BRIDGE_PRIORITY_MAX_VALID.desc: STP_MST_INST bridge_priority 61440, the largest multiple of 4096, is accepted.

MSTP_INSTANCE_BRIDGE_PRIORITY_NOT_MULTIP.desc: STP_MST_INST bridge_priority that is not a multiple of 4096 is rejected.

MSTP_INSTANCE_BRIDGE_PRIORITY_RANGE.desc: STP_MST_INST bridge_priority above 61440 is out of range.

MSTP_GLOBAL_FWD_DELAY_RANGE.desc: STP global forward_delay above 30 is out of range.

MSTP_PORT_PRIORITY_RANGE.desc: STP_MST_PORT priority above 240 is out of range.

PVST_PORT_PRIORITY_NOT_MULTIPLE.desc: STP_PORT priority that is not a multiple of 16 is rejected.

PVST_PORT_PRIORITY_MAX_VALID.desc: STP_PORT priority 240, the largest multiple of 16, is accepted.

PVST_VLAN_PORT_PRIORITY_NOT_MULTIPLE.desc: STP_VLAN_PORT priority that is not a multiple of 16 is rejected.

MSTP_PORT_PRIORITY_NOT_MULTIPLE.desc: STP_MST_PORT priority that is not a multiple of 16 is rejected.

MSTP_PORT_PRIORITY_MULTIPLE_VALID.desc: STP_MST_PORT priority 16, a multiple of 16, is accepted.

MSTP_PORT_INVALID_IFNAME.desc: STP_MST_PORT ifname must be an existing port or port channel.

MSTP_PORT_INVALID_INSTANCE.desc: STP_MST_PORT inst_id must reference an existing STP_MST_INST (leafref).

MSTP_GLOBAL_MISSING_MODE.desc: STP global requires the mandatory 'mode' leaf.

STP_PORT_IFNAME_NOT_A_PORT.desc: STP_PORT ifname must be an existing port or port channel.

STP_VLAN_PORT_WITHOUT_STP_PORT.desc: STP_VLAN_PORT needs an STP_PORT row for the same interface.
eStr: Configure spanning tree on the interface first

STP_VLAN_PORT_VALID.desc: STP_VLAN_PORT is accepted when the interface has an STP_PORT row.

STP_MST_PORT_WITHOUT_STP_PORT.desc: STP_MST_PORT needs an STP_PORT row for the same interface.
eStr: Configure spanning tree on the interface first

MSTP_REGION_WITH_STP_DISABLED.desc: STP_MST region config is kept while spanning tree is disabled (no STP GLOBAL row).

MSTP_DISABLED_KEEPS_INSTANCE_AND_PORT_RO.desc: What a disable leaves behind validates with no STP GLOBAL row: region, instance, per-instance port and a stripped STP_PORT.

MSTP_LINK_TYPE_WITH_STP_DISABLED.desc: link_type is mode-only and is rejected while spanning tree is disabled (no STP GLOBAL row).
eStr: Configuration allowed in MST mode only
